cohort: Participants were 62,155 women who had deliveries at "Queen Geraldine" Obstetrics & Gynecology University Hospital, Tirana, over a 10-year period (2015-2024).
finding: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy incidence varied significantly over a decade, with higher prevalence in urban areas and among women aged 25-34 years, and a significant association with increased cesarean section rates and prolonged maternal and newborn hospital stays.
mod_finding: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy were significantly associated with increased cesarean section rates.
